715160101.text: Such a great end to the play. You've done well, young one. How did you find it? Was it hard to perform with paper?

715160103.text: Paper plays are different from Liyue Operas. Being able to do everything yourself makes things a lot simpler.

715160106.text: #Paimon thinks {NICKNAME} did pretty well. The script itself for the paper play is also very interesting! Paimon wants to see a new story. Yinggong, when will you perform next time?

715160107.text: Haha, as long as someone enjoys it. As for next time, I don't know.

715160108.text: You see, doing paper plays for kids is actually a hobby of mine. After this, I will return to the Yun-Han Opera Troupe to handle the wardrobe and props.

715160109.text: Eh? You're with the Yun-Han Opera Troupe? So you can also sing Liyue Opera.

715160110.text: I can, to some extent. Who wouldn't be able to carry a tune after staying with the Yun-Han Opera Troupe for so long? Of course, I'm nothing when compared to Ms. Yun.

715160111.text: I actually work with the people behind the scenes. I'm in charge of the wardrobe and props on stage, such as cannons, flags, costumes, accessories, gadgets... Whatever prop you saw on stage, that was me.

715160112.text: Some of the costumes and props that the Yun-Han Opera Troupe uses today are hand-me-downs from the past, and others were bought or made by myself.

715160113.text: To perform an entire Liyue Opera, there are a lot of people working on stage and behind the scenes. You can't make it happen with just a few actors and actresses.

715160114.text: This year's Lantern Rite, Ms. Yun gave some of us backstage helpers some time off, and all of my colleagues are back home to spend the holidays.

715160115.text: I've got all this time on my hands, so I decided to put on a paper play for the people here.

715160117.text: No, I didn't go home. My mother and father passed away two years ago, so it's just me now.

715160105.text: You're not a performer by trade, so of course you'd be bound to make some mistakes on your first try.
